newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Rakvere in demand on Tallinn bourse.
newsitem.headline: Rakvere in demand on Tallinn bourse.

text.p: Rakvere meat factory was in high demand on Wednesday, rising 0.75 kroons to 15.50 in trade of 16.2 million kroons. Most other prices were stable on Tallinn's bourse, dealers said.
Overall market volume was 55 million kroons versus 63 million kroons on Tuesday and the TALSE index inched down 0.02 percent to close at 259.10.
"It (Rakvere) had an exceptional turnover and its trade in large blocks was also unusual," one dealer said, adding that such volumes usually heralded news .
However officials at Rakvere said the only news due soon was the audited version of its 1996 results.
On the main list, interest in Hansapank continued.
Hansa saw turnover of 17.35 kroons and its price climbed 0.27 kroons to close at 135.27 kroons.
Tallinna Pank was the biggest loser on the main list, to close at 63.30 kroons versus 64.05 kroons.
One dealer said investors might start selling Hoiupank and Hansapank later this week and start buying Forekspank and Tallinna Pank, which have fallen.
Dealers said no big change is expected on the market.
"The main attention now is directed at the new shares coming to the market," one dealer said.
